metadata.title: Content Production
metadata.description: Callable entry point for a client-configured SEO article factory ending in a verified WordPress draft.
metadata.author: RAINMOJO SO

configuration.purpose: Validate and dispatch either the shared generic engine or a declared client-native production adapter.

model_draft_review_guidance._scope: DECISION GUIDANCE ONLY, applied inside the structured content review record. Declares no pipeline state, no ledger column, no status token.
model_draft_review_guidance.two_pass_review: Pass 1 claim walk (verified with source, wrong, could not verify); pass 2 expert omission audit written before rereading; pass 2 outranks pass 1; a named human signs off on both with a date.
model_draft_review_guidance.engine_attribution: Record the producing engine beside the class check; could not verify when unknown.

outbound_link_qualification.record: target URL, reason class, rel assigned, topical-relation verdict

prerequisites: Client CLAUDE.md and content-pipeline.json are present
Brand, client profile, and site configuration are readable
The configured engine and adapter pass validation
phases: Dispatch the generic engine or the declared end-to-end client-native operations
Record structured content review bound to the current article SHA-256
Coordinate image generation, processing, provenance, and visual QA
Verify or reconcile the final draft
success_criteria: Content review names a reviewer, passes every checklist item, and matches the current article SHA-256
Required product, pillar, related, and external links match the plan
Every image passed technical and structured visual QA
Post, media, taxonomy, links, and SEO fields verify
